title: Mint canaries and self-testing documents: does the composition layer adopt it
description: These claims set out the Sémantique Potentielle mint, which extends Queneau's method from verse to concept and whose constraint-minted terms and forensic canaries signal access if they appear in a composition-layer response, and the mint-battery-registry apparatus that tests adoption. Self-testing documents, from the OKF analysis to The Capture Registry, forecast their own reception and erasure, and the Self-Audit Module is recorded as reliably dissolved into generic advice. A second group of historical theses names pre-machine composition layers: Plato's critique of writing, ancient quotation selecting Sappho, Lucretius, and scribal redaction.
